messages:
partners-eng: Hey team — vendor 'LogStream' wants a live SIEM export. They need access to our security events for their analytics. What are the minimal RBAC + KMS steps we need to onboard them?
lucy-sec: We should treat them as an external consumer. Minimum: dedicated S3 prefix, customer-managed KMS key (restricted), and a time-limited IAM role for cross-account access.
partners-eng: Got it. Any retention/PII redaction requirements we should tell them up front?
tariq-iam: Retention: default raw events = 90 days in hot tier, 1 year in cold archive. We cannot export raw PII fields. If partner needs names/emails we need a data-sharing agreement + field-level redaction policy.
compliance: +1 on data-sharing agreement. Also require they pass our security questionnaire and sign that they won't persist logs beyond agreed retention. Need a DB of approvals.
sam-oncall: Operational note — on external exports we should have an automatic audit trail: who assumed role, when, and which prefixes were accessed. infra-bot, can we add access logs to the export bucket and pipe to internal SIEM?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: export-bucket ACL updated, server-side logging enabled for s3://siem-exports/partner-logstream/. CloudTrail data events for S3 enabled for that prefix.
lucy-sec: For RBAC: create an IAM role in our account with a very narrow policy: s3:GetObject on s3://siem-exports/partner-logstream/* and kms:Decrypt only for the dedicated CMK. Role requires MFA and external ID. Provide sts:AssumeRole with session duration 1 hour.
partners-eng: Do we have a template policy for the CMK grants so we can share with them?
tariq-iam: I'll produce a template. Key restrictions: allow use from specific account IDs, disallow key rotation by partner, audit key usage to CloudTrail. Grant is for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey only.
compliance: Also add requirement: partners must not be allowed to re-export logs to public endpoints. Enforcement: occasional automated scan and contractual clause.
sam-oncall: For incidents: If the partner's queries look suspicious, we should have a quick-cutoff playbook — revoke role, rotate CMK if needed, and notify partner-CIRT. Lucy, can you draft that?
lucy-sec: Yup. Draft outline: 1) Suspend role (IAM deny), 2) Block network egress for partner endpoint via firewall rule, 3) Rotate CMK if key compromise suspected, 4) Notify legal & compliance, 5) Start incident review. I'll attach a step-by-step runbook.
partners-eng: Timeline: partner asks to start next week — can we have initial checklist by Friday?
tariq-iam: I'll have CMK policy + role template by Thursday.
lucy-sec: I'll have the redaction checklist, playbook, and acceptance criteria by Friday EOD.
compliance: I'll prepare the DSA (data-sharing agreement) stub for legal review.
partners-eng: Perfect. Final question: object lifecycle — should we enforce server-side lifecycle to auto-delete after 90 days?
lucy-sec: Yes. Apply lifecycle rule: transition to glacier-looking cold tier after 30 days, expire after 365 days for archived; for hot raw we expire after 90. Also add object lock retention mode 'GOVERNANCE' for the first 7 days to prevent accidental deletes.
sam-oncall: I'll add alerting for unusual egress rates and large bulk downloads.
partners-eng: Thanks — please @me when templates are up. :thumbsup:
lucy-sec: @partners-eng will do. :eyes: 
infra-bot: deploy-bot: note: role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/siem-external-partner-template created (template only).
partners-eng: Received. Closing loop once docs land. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
